item.description:

Field: Physics / 02/PHYS-03 Fisica sperimentale della materia e applicazioni

The project aims to develop and apply machine-learning and integrative modeling approaches to characterize conformational ensembles of non-canonical nucleic acids, with particular emphasis on G-quadruplexes. Experimental data from spectroscopic and scattering techniques will be combined with multiscale simulations and data-driven methods. The goal is to identify structural descriptors and relationships among sequence, topology, compactness, stability, and ligand interactions. item.title: Incarico post-doc: Thermodynamic cost of Quantum Extreme Learning Machines (Univ. PALERMO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-31 23:59
Institution: Univ. PALERMO, Palermo
Field: Physics / 02/PHYS-04 Fisica teorica della materia, modelli, metodi matematici e applicazioni

Extreme Learning Machines (ELMs) are feed-forward neural networks with a single hidden layer and random couplings, trained via linear regression, saving time and resources. Their quantum counterparts (QELMs) use a quantum reservoir to build complex representations of classical data, with inexpensive, noise-robust performance. The Quantum Theory Group at UNIPA has demonstrated the advantages of QELMs for validating and certifying quantum systems without tomographic reconstruction. These algorithms apply to the optimisation of complex processes, quantum and classical, on NISQ machines, to the energetic characterisation of biochemical systems simulated on quantum computers, and to the…
